commands.name: ResolveWfmSourceTerminalConsequence
steps: pure-preflight validates identifiers, positive source_projection_revision, exact lowercase input_fingerprint, closed decision and bounded reason without reading owner state
exact command replay resolves before prepare/owner-state reads and returns the immutable original response without recomputing source/local review authority

inside one writer UoW require source_terminal_review_id is the exact pending review for task_id with matching source_projection_revision and stored input_fingerprint; a missing/superseded/nonpending/different review returns WFM_SOURCE_TERMINAL_STALE before receipt, while missing Task returns TASK_NOT_FOUND

reconcile current accepted wfm_source_projection_cache and require provider_lifecycle_class remains complete|plan_cancel, source_projection_revision and review lifecycle class match exactly, accepted_source_observation_id remains present, and current source evidence remains the review source authority; source drift returns WFM_SOURCE_TERMINAL_STALE before receipt

recompute SOMA_WFM_SOURCE_TERMINAL_REVIEW_V1 from the exact current source projection, contiguous execution authority, current operational plan pointer, current Objective membership plus aggregate consequence, and explicit lock authority; require byte-equivalent input_fingerprint or return WFM_SOURCE_TERMINAL_STALE before receipt

for retain_local_work, insert one receipt then transition only that review pending->retain_local_work with revision+1, decided_at_utc and last_command_id; provider source projection, Task revision/execution/outcome/plan/membership and Objective projections remain unchanged

for terminate_local_work, require current-effective execution is not already ended/terminated; insert one receipt, append exactly one source_terminal_consequence execution event at prior execution revision+1, rebuild execution projection to terminated, increment tasks.revision exactly once, transition the same review pending->terminate_local_work with revision+1 and local_consequence_event_id equal to that exact event, while Task outcome remains unchanged

after terminate_local_work rebuild the affected Objective aggregate from exact current member authority; if already-started Objective work loses its final executable Task derive lost_last_executable/Awaiting Review, otherwise surviving work remains represented without silent membership restructuring

append one task.source_terminal_consequence_resolved.v1 audit event binding review/source evidence/fingerprint/decision and optional execution event, then commit the exact immutable response atomically
rules: never modifies provider status/source evidence, Task outcome or Objective membership
provider Complete/Plan Cancel alone does not execute this command
terminal Objective membership is not silently restructured
SOMA_WFM_SOURCE_TERMINAL_REVIEW_V1 is both producer and resolver freshness authority; stale review rows are preserved/superseded rather than rewritten
recording time and UUID lexical order never establish source/execution/review chronology
